meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 执行计划时只做“编排”:选计划、拆任务、记进度,把开发、测试、审核全部委派给并行子代理,自己不碰代码,最后产出结果或开拉取请求。
howto.when: 当你说“start work”“execute plan”“continue plan”等短语,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。

say.text: 开始执行 .omo/plans 里的 my-plan 计划
say.note: 先读计划,再派子代理并行完成。
会从下一个未勾选任务继续。

say.text: 以 PR 方式执行 plan-3
say.note: 会创建独立分支并打开拉取请求。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates plan execution: picks the plan, splits tasks, tracks progress, and delegates every implementation/test/review step to parallel sub-agents. It never edits product code; it outputs results or opens a PR at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.text: Start executing the my-plan plan in .omo/plans
say_en.note: It reads the plan, then dispatches sub-agents in parallel.
It resumes from the next unchecked task.
It creates a branch and opens a pull request.
